rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Data Storage on Device
rules.description: Detects mobile app data storage issues including unencrypted SQLite databases and shared preferences
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "mobile" or Message contains "data-storage" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3

rules.name: Mobile — Insecure Network Communication
rules.description: Detects mobile apps communicating over HTTP, using weak TLS, or accepting self-signed certificates
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "mobile" or Message contains "network" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
